title: "02 Exploratory Data Analysis"
author: "BIS15L DOC Project"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

analysis_df <- read_csv("../data/analysis_df.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Coverage Counts

```{r}
analysis_df %>%
  summarize(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_lakes = n_distinct(lake),
    n_species = n_distinct(fish_species),
    n_regions = n_distinct(region),
    year_min = min(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    year_max = max(year, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Numeric Summary

```{r}
analysis_df %>%
  summarize(
    mean_doc = mean(doc_mgl, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_length = mean(length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pelagic = mean(pelagic_diet_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_trophic = mean(trophic_position, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## EDA Plot 1: DOC Distribution

```{r}
ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = doc_mgl)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4B8BBE", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of DOC across fish samples",
    x = "DOC (mg/L)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## EDA Plot 2: Length by Species

```{r}
ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = fish_species, y = length_mm, fill = fish_species)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Fish length by species",
    x = "Fish species",
    y = "Length (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
